name: Article 2, after § 8 – 341
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 8b. A declaration, recommendation or other act of the World Health Organization shall not, in itself, activate assistance or other operational measures under this Regulation, create obligations for Member States or authorise measures on their territory. Any action under this Regulation shall comply with its applicable conditions and procedures and with paragraph 8a. This paragraph shall be without prejudice to obligations arising independently under other Union law or international agreements.
